stem: Approximately what percentage of children with ADHD have at least one comorbid condition?
explanation: 80% is the best answer because most children with ADHD have at least one additional comorbid condition, such as a learning difficulty or emotional disorder.

optionExplanations.A: Correct because the prevalence of at least one comorbid condition in children with ADHD is very high, around 80%.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because 10% is far below the expected rate of comorbidity in children with ADHD.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because 50% underestimates how common additional conditions are in this group.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because 25% is still too low compared with the typical prevalence of comorbidity in ADHD.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because 5% is much lower than the proportion of children with ADHD who have at least one comorbid condition.

source.hint: The prevalence of having at least one additional condition is very high, exceeding three-quarters of cases.
